picks.headline: OpenAI Launches Decisions API for Fast, Low-Cost App Workflows
picks.why: Provides a specialized API endpoint targeting low-latency, budget-conscious decision routing in agentic applications.
picks.title: Build more responsive apps with the Decisions API

picks.headline: Anthropic Donates Agent Skills Standard to Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation
picks.why: Establishes an open, vendor-neutral governance framework for standardized agent tool definitions across the ecosystem.
picks.title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation

picks.headline: PyTorch NA 2026 Adds Native Support for Google TPUs and AWS Trainium
picks.why: Expands multi-hardware portability by bringing first-class compiler and runtime backends for non-NVIDIA AI chips.
picks.title: PyTorch Conference North America 2026: Accelerating Open Intelligence Together

picks.headline: IQuest-Q1 Releases Open 320B Sparse MoE Model for CLI Agents
picks.why: Delivers an open 320B foundation model (15B activated) optimized specifically for command-line software engineering agents.
picks.title: IQuest-Q1: Advancing Foundation Capabilities for Agentic CLI Systems

picks.headline: Audit Shows Deleting Source Memories Fails to Erase Derived Agent Knowledge
picks.why: Reveals that deleting root data in LLM agents leaves sensitive information intact within descendant downstream states.
picks.title: AfterDeleteBench: Auditing Post-Deletion Information Persistence in LLM Agents

picks.headline: LLVMhammer Attack Uses Rowhammer Bit-Flips to Degrade GPU LLM Inference
picks.why: Demonstrates physical DRAM attacks against Triton's compiler pipeline that permanently increase inference latency and cost.
picks.title: Amplifying Latency and Cost of LLM Inference via Rowhammer Attack

picks.headline: NVIDIA Announces Minerva Observability Platform to Maximize AI Factory GPU Uptime
picks.why: Combines telemetry across compute, networking, and storage to diagnose yield losses and performance degradation in massive clusters.
picks.title: NVIDIA Unveils Minerva to Bring End-to-End Observability for AI Factories

papers.headline: Deep Fusion Memory Injects Parametric Context Without Online Vector Retrieval
papers.why: Predicts context memory chunks and fuses them directly into LLM intermediate states using gated cross-attention.
papers.title: Deep Fusion Memory: A Chunk-Level Parametric Memory for Large Language Models

papers.headline: Heartbeat Thinking Lets Voice Agents Speculatively Reason While User Speaks
papers.why: Prevents tool cancellation during real-time speech by executing speculative reasoning continuously as transcripts update.
papers.title: Heartbeat Thinking: Speculative Reasoning and Tool Execution While Listening in Realtime Voice Agents

papers.headline: Adaptive Sequence Models Found Leaking Future Tokens Despite Causal Masks
papers.why: Reveals that full-sequence routing summaries can break causal invariance in autoregressive architectures even with strict causal attention masks.
papers.title: Beyond Causal Masks: Auditing and Localizing Hidden Future-Token Leakage in Adaptive Sequence Models
